# Stress regression sources

`AMB_HOSP.CNV` is the unmodified official relation from the Ministry of
Health/DataSUS `TAB_CNES.zip`, retrieved in the 2026-10-14 intensive audit.
Source: `ftp://ftp.datasus.gov.br/dissemin/publicos/CNES/200508_/Auxiliar/TAB_CNES.zip`.
Member SHA-256: `d69f9f2383b0234d981b1385c47acd68a1047e0301223c891c080795acce89c3`.
Its original encoding and CRLF bytes are preserved on every platform.

The four one-character flags beginning at `AMB_NSUS` form the four-character
relation key. The first records of `SRAC0802.dbc` and `SRAC0803.dbc` contain
`0100` and `1000`, respectively. The test writes those literal fields and their
physical widths explicitly. Under the package's documented last-physical-rule
precedence, the final category 17 (`0000-9999`) overrides the earlier categories
for both keys; the expected label is transcribed directly from this member.

The source-context tests also retain literal `ATE_INTERN` dates and municipal
`PRE_MUNIRE` codes from the saved stress cases. Additional unknown/leading-zero
codes are synthetic boundary cases. No expected values are generated by a
processor, and the fixtures contain no personal identifiers.
